required_distinctions.distinction: The five verdicts preserve their different meanings: supported satisfaction, supported failure, undecided evidence, missing bound scope/capability, and invalid subject/basis/interpretation. A verdict answers its original exact predicate, not dispatch or an easier admission predicate.

Performance is separately performed, not_performed or unconfirmed, recording actual extent and interruption. Performed permits any verdict and proves no satisfaction alone; not_performed and unconfirmed cannot be satisfied. An interrupted witnessed failure is not a never-run test.

Separately admissible counterevidence or a supported basis/scope diagnosis can decide a non-performed or unconfirmed predicate without inventing execution. An absent return proves neither non-performance nor indeterminacy: a missing required judgment remains an absent slot with known performance or uncertainty, not a fabricated child result.

The required set comes from applicability/coverage, not received returns. Authenticate contributions; in an interpretable composite, applicable authenticated required falsification dominates while gaps survive, then required invalid_basis, then out_of_frame, then other undecided coverage. Satisfaction requires all applicable predicates and joins plus established coverage. An uninterpretable composite basis yields invalid_basis while retaining component failures; a false required join cannot be relabelled as failed admission.

Apply a universal invalid-basis override that hides a false material join or an authenticated component failure.

probes.title: Assurance accounts for authorship, dependence and numeric limits
probes.source_selected_question: Does agreement by different actors establish independence or a probability of product correctness, and what evidence is needed for a numerical assurance claim?

source_loci.heading: Independent assessment
source_loci.quote: an author of the reviewed subject or repair. Self-review remains authoring

source_loci.heading: Parallel assurance and provenance
source_loci.quote: codebases do not establish statistical independence. Repeating an observation

source_loci.heading: Risk and assurance selection
source_loci.quote: operational failures. Unsupported numerical confidence remains unresolved;

required_distinctions.distinction: Independent assessment is claim-relative and selected by the governing contract. Where nonauthor assessment is required, the assessor cannot author the reviewed subject/repair; self-review stays authoring evidence. Fresh contexts, identities or model families alone do not establish independence, and this contract adds no universal reviewer count or model-family requirement.

Preserve assertion provenance (obligation, interpretation, assumptions, derivation, shared dependencies) separately from execution provenance (actual checker, exact subject, environment, inputs, observations, result). Agreement admits common error and disagreement needs diagnosis; actors/families/codebases and repetitions do not establish statistical independence or new evidence. Model validation needs purpose and material external observations through owners.

A quantified claim declares population/uncertainty model, prior information, likelihoods, shared causes and calibration limits. Bayes requires defined used conditionals and a nonzero denominator; exact joint miss factorization uses conditioning on preceding misses, and replacing factors by marginal conditional miss rates requires relevant conditional independence.

One minus joint miss probability is chance of at least one detection under the specified conditions, not whole-product correctness. Agreement need not increase confidence; sampled/injected cases calibrate only their justified operational relation. Unsupported numeric confidence stays unresolved while scoped qualitative evidence remains usable. No universal probability threshold or per-test estimate is imposed; safety, authority and acceptance requirements constrain cheaper plans.

prohibited_distortions: Claim independent review or statistically independent failures from different actors, fresh contexts or model families alone.
Use execution logs to justify the upstream expected answer or infer the faulty party solely from disagreement.
Multiply miss rates without the needed independence model, turn detection probability into product-correctness probability, or invent priors/calibration.
Treat unsupported confidence as established, mandate a universal numerical threshold, or waive required gates for a cheaper assurance plan.
probes.significance: Graphify confidence, repeated model agreement and test counts can otherwise be mistaken for semantic assurance or acceptance without their required causal and authority account.
